newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH PSE ADDS THREE ISSUES TO CONTINUOUS TRADING. [CORRECTED 15:08 GMT]
newsitem.headline: CZECH PSE ADDS THREE ISSUES TO CONTINUOUS TRADING. [CORRECTED 15:08 GMT]

text.p: The Prague Stock Exchange on Wednesday said it would add three issues to its continuous trading session.
A PSE statement said engineering concern Skoda , bank IPB , investment fund SPIF Cesky would be added to the continuous session as of November 4.
The statement added that the PSE had also decided to merge the second and third trading groups within the bourse's free market, effective January 1.
Stocks in the second group have their prices fixed once a session, while the shares in the third group have their prices fixed twice weekly.
Prices in the merged group will be fixed daily.
Seven equity issues and two bonds are currently traded in the continuous session, which begins at 1145 local time (0945 GMT) (corrects time) and runs until 1400 (1200 GMT).
The PSE adopted the continuous trading session as a step toward the implementation of full real time trading.
